rationale: Georgi is building Rilo, an AI-agent platform for GTM automation, and is actively hiring for execution-focused roles—Saurabh is a backend engineer turned AI engineer with hands-on experience building agentic tools and AI-adjacent automation projects in Python and JavaScript. intro_message: Georgi, meet Saurabh Khire—an AI engineer at HiJenny AI who's been building agentic coding tools and automation projects; given your GTM Lead hiring push, his backend and AI engineering background could be a strong fit for the team.
